description: Fixed participant-level train/validation/test assignment for C2 glucose forecasting. Every C2 dataset must be split with this file so assignments never change when participants are missing or excluded.
id_format: Three-digit zero-padded strings matching the CGMacros-### folder names.
origin: Recorded from the existing split files cgmacros_train.csv and cgmacros_validation.csv (created 2026-10-09). The original split_dataset.py sorted the 45 participant IDs as integers, shuffled them with numpy.random.default_rng(42), and assigned 31 to train, 7 to validation and 7 to test.
verification: Re-running that original procedure on the 45 participant folder IDs reproduces the train and validation lists exactly. The test list is the 7 remaining participant folders; cgmacros_test.csv was not opened.
